title: Collinear 4-tuples Force Collinear 5-tuples
exact_target: Must every large point set with a fixed positive quadratic number of collinear four-point subsets contain five collinear points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 132 (GREEN-044). CC BY 4.0.
József Solymosi and Miloš Stojaković, \emph{Many collinear $k$-tuples with no $k+1$ collinear points}, Discrete \& Computational Geometry 50 (2013), 811--820, §1, Erdős conjecture for $r=5,k=4$.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 71 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
